case.summary: Transaction 3478782 for $292.36 on card C11891-K1 was flagged by an elevated legacy real-time risk score of 0.79. The calibrated second-generation model scored the transaction low at 0.115, and holder history demonstrated consistent channel, product category, and email domain usage with no prior fraud. Graph analysis identified no connection to fraud rings, no suspicious device sharing, and no velocity or card-testing anomalies in the 14-day window. The alert is determined to be a false alarm and the activity is cleared as legitimate.
